{{short description|German industrial chemist}}
'''Lieselotte Feikes''' (1923 in [[Viersen]] - 29 January 2008) was a German chemist.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.gdch.de/fileadmin/downloads/Netzwerk_und_Strukturen/Fachgruppen/AKCC/chemikerinnen_akcc.pdf|title=Chemikerinnen|website=www.gdch.de|access-date=2019-01-12}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|last1=Schwarzl|first1=Sonja M.|last2=Hertel|first2=Marion|date=2002|title=Zum Beispiel: Liselotte Feikes|journal=Nachrichten aus der Chemie|language=de|volume=50|issue=5|pages=639–640|doi=10.1002/nadc.20020500532|issn=1868-0054}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|date=1953|title=Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker - Neuanmeldungen|journal=Nachrichten aus Chemie und Technik|language=en|volume=1|issue=8|pages=65–68|doi=10.1002/nadc.19530010812|issn=1868-0054}}</ref> She is known for her work in the leather chemistry and the development of wastewater treatment processes.

== Life ==
Starting in 1943, Feikes studied chemistry at the [[Halle University]] at the Institute of [[Karl Ziegler]] and at the [[Heidelberg University]]. She earned her doctorate with [[Margot Becke-Goehring]] at the [[Heidelberg University]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /> In 1953, she joined the [[Freudenberg Group|Carl Freudenberg Werke]] in Weinheim.<ref name=":0" /> She headed the leather laboratory for 20 years and developed wastewater treatment processes for wastewater treatment plants.<ref name=":0" /> Since the beginning of the 1970s, she was responsible for environmental protection in the company.<ref name=":0" /> In 1983, she wrote the book "Ökologische Probleme der Lederindustrie".<ref name=":0" /> She was awarded the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]] for her services to environmental protection.<ref name=":0" /> Feikes died on 29 January 2008 in [[Weinheim]], Germany.<ref>{{cite web |title=Lieselotte Feikes (1923-2008): Im Dienst des Umweltschutzes |url=https://www.gdch.de/publikationen/biographien-von-chemikerinnen/lieselotte-feikes.html |publisher=Deutsche Chemische Gesellschaft (DChG) |access-date=29 September 2021 |language=German}}</ref>

== Awards ==
She received the following awards:

* 1979 Yearly prize of the Verein für Gerberei-Chemie<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.vgct.de/ueber-uns/auszeichnungen/jahrespreis|title=Jahrespreis|website=VGCT - Verein für Gerberei-Chemie und -Technik e.V.|language=de-DE|access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref>
* 1984 Honorary member of the Verein Österreichischer Ledertechniker<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.voelt-rosensteingasse.at/styled-5/|title=Ehrenmitglieder {{!}} VÖLT|website=www.voelt-rosensteingasse.at|access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref>
* 1986 [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]]<ref name=":1" />
* 1986 Arthur Wilson Memorial Lecture<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://leatherchemists.org/index.php/our-rich-history/|title=Our Rich History – ALCA|language=en-US|access-date=2019-01-19}}</ref>
